quality_notes: No trades and no position boxes; only analysis. The transcript is unusable for detail: bias, the pullback-then-close condition and the Powell context rest on a few reconstructed fragments. Levels are seen axis labels, but their role (target vs support) is inferred. The chart timezone is not displayed. ET is inferred because the 4h bars are labelled 06:00 (CME session-anchored bars at 18/22/02/06 ET) and a sharp NQ spike appears at about 10:05 on Wed 6 Mar (Powell 10:00 ET). The 4h countdown in #18 reads '0?:30:21'; the first digit is blurry, and 00 is taken because it matches the 1h countdown. The later x-axis labels 'Fri 08 Mar' and 'Mon 11 Mar' (#24, #33, #38) are crosshair positions in empty future space, not data. The outcome of the Thu 7 Mar plan is not shown.
